t: You're looking at a stained-glass panel called Entombment, made by Gerhard Remisch. It shows Jesus Christ, laid in the tomb after the crucifixion. Remisch is credited as the maker, and the panel is a religious work, meant to be looked at slowly. The material I have is thin, so I'll leave it there. Take a moment with the colours and the figures, and notice how the light coming through the glass changes how the scene looks.
